note: Divi's reports one segment. Each quarter the CFO discloses the generics : custom synthesis revenue split (generics INCLUDE nutraceuticals: 'the disclosure of 41% generic, which includes nutraceuticals', Q4FY22 call), the nutraceutical revenue, the constant-currency growth and the forex gain/loss. Revenue = consolidated revenue from operations (Screener). csRev = csPct x revenue; genRev = genPct x revenue - nutraRev (generic APIs ex-nutraceuticals); both derived by GAM from the company's rounded percentages, so they carry +/-0.5% of revenue of rounding. grossMarginPct = 100 - material cost % (Screener). Q2FY25 and Q4FY26 splits are implied from half-year / full-year disclosures.
